admissionInfo.text: ENGL 2010 and MATH QL courses must have a grade C or higher. Successful completion of ASL 3060 American Sign Language Proficiency. GPA of 3.0 or higher with no grade lower than a B- in content area courses. Completion of all General Education requirements and 70% of content area courses. Pass LiveScan Criminal Background Check.
